title: Catch a signal
summary: signal() installs a handler; raise() sends the signal to yourself.
hints: `void handler(int sig)` is the function; `signal(SIGUSR1, handler);` installs it. Name the unused parameter in a cast: `(void)sig;`.
In the handler print with `write(STDOUT_FILENO, ..., len)`: it does not wait in a stdio buffer. Print the main line with `printf` after `raise` returns.
